description: Dropdown to choose one value from a list, with groups, typeahead and scroll buttons, built on Reka UI.

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SelectRootEmits, SelectRootProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { SelectRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useFieldContext } from '@/components/ui/field'

const props = defineProps<SelectRootProps>()
const emits = defineEmits<SelectRootEmits>()

// Inside an ElfField the select also reports the field's required state (aria-required on the trigger).
const field = useFieldContext()
const required = computed(() => props.required || Boolean(field?.required.value))

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <SelectRoot v-slot="slotProps" v-bind="forwarded" :required="required">
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </SelectRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SelectContentEmits, SelectContentProps } from 'reka-ui'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { SelectContent, SelectPortal, SelectViewport, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import SelectScrollDownButton from './SelectScrollDownButton.vue'
import SelectScrollUpButton from './SelectScrollUpButton.vue'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectContentProps & {
  /** Extra classes, merged with the base classes through `cn()`. */
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}>(), {
  position: 'popper',
  sideOffset: 4,
})
const emits = defineEmits<SelectContentEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <SelectPortal>
    <SelectContent
      data-slot="select-content"
      v-bind="{ ...$attrs, ...forwarded }"
      :class="cn(
        'relative z-50 max-h-(--reka-select-content-available-height) min-w-32 origin-(--reka-select-content-transform-origin) overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto rounded-md border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-md data-[state=closed]:animate-[elf-fade-out_100ms_ease-in_forwards] data-[state=open]:animate-[elf-fade-in_120ms_ease-out] motion-reduce:animate-none!',
        props.position === 'popper' && 'min-w-(--reka-select-trigger-width)',
        props.class,
      )"
    >
      <SelectScrollUpButton />
      <SelectViewport :class="cn('p-1', props.position === 'popper' && 'w-full scroll-my-1')">
        <slot />
      </SelectViewport>
      <SelectScrollDownButton />
    </SelectContent>
  </SelectPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SelectTriggerProps } from './index'
import { ChevronDown } from '@lucide/vue'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { SelectIcon, SelectTrigger, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { selectTriggerVariants } from './index'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectTriggerProps>(), {
  size: 'default',
})
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'size', 'invalid')
const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <SelectTrigger
    data-slot="select-trigger"
    :data-size="props.size"
    v-bind="forwardedProps"
    :aria-invalid="props.invalid ? 'true' : undefined"
    :class="cn(selectTriggerVariants({ size: props.size }), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
    <SelectIcon as-child>
      <ChevronDown class="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
    </SelectIcon>
  </SelectTrigger>
</template>
